title: Hyde School
excerpt: A co-ed boarding school in Bath, Maine, founded in 1966 by Joseph Gauld and run by the Gauld family since. Survivors describe forced labor, peer surveillance, public confession and unlicensed therapy; a 2025 federal class action alleges labor trafficking and abuse.
